# [TASK] Chat widget loading/error states and accessibility pass

## Task
Loading/error states and accessibility pass for the chat widget.

## Scope
Polish layer on top of Tasks #1/#2 — not new functionality.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A failed send shows a clear error state without discarding the user's typed message (per #197 AC4)
- [ ] A pending request shows a visible loading indicator (e.g. assistant "typing")
- [ ] Automated accessibility check (e.g. axe) passes on the widget
- [ ] Screen-reader announcement when a new assistant message arrives

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3
